_comment: Configuration de generate-photos.py (génération locale FLUX.2 klein, V2.120.0)
_doc: Consigne = « Photo culinaire : {nom}. Ingrédients visibles : {5 principaux}. » + per_type[type] + base_style. Style = plateforme de marque (juin) : chaleureux, lumière du jour, table de famille.
base_style: Warm home food photography, soft natural daylight from a window, family table, linen napkin, handmade ceramic tableware, seasonal ingredients scattered around, 45 degree angle, shallow depth of field, appetizing and realistic, no text, no people, no hands

per_type.lunch: Served as a generous lunch plate.
per_type.dinner: Served as a cosy family dinner.
per_type.dessert: Served as a dessert in a small bowl or plate.

_overrides_doc: Description du plat à la place du nom, quand le nom induit le modèle en erreur (ex. « sandwich » → pain). Clé = id de recette.

overrides.b108: Onigirazu : a square Japanese rice sandwich made of cooked quinoa wrapped in a sheet of dark green nori seaweed, cut in half to show neat layers of smoked salmon, avocado slices and cucumber, sprinkled with sesame seeds. Absolutely no bread, the outside is only black-green nori seaweed
overrides.d75: A thick slice of baked frittata (Italian oven omelette, no pastry at all) served on a plate, golden egg with visible courgette slices, crumbled goat cheese and thyme inside, the cut side showing the fluffy egg texture
overrides.d103: A thick slice of baked frittata (Italian oven omelette, no pastry at all) served on a plate, golden egg with visible courgette, crumbled feta and fresh mint leaves inside, the cut side showing the fluffy egg texture
overrides.s44: Small round egg muffins (mini frittatas baked in a muffin tin, no pastry at all), golden puffy egg with chopped leek and fresh goat cheese, a few unmoulded on a small plate
